pr_title: revert multiline string refactor in JsonThrowablePatternConverterTests
pr_body:
the test relies on line separator which is platform specific and use of
multiline string can cause it to fail in Windows

closes #81803
closes #81810

comments: @arteam could this be related to the work you've been doing around Java 15 text blocks?

I think it's a Windows specific failure, probably because of https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/commit/763d6d510f0792a9e3743a413605127316859dde#diff-acb6ebe9cbfcf90264293f1edf71ce2cfc08e47140bc5a7a0b47cbe7d6046ae9L24.

@astefan great observation
I will revert that test as it do not benefit from refactoring

Please can you backport the fix for this to 8.0 - it's failing on that branch too, for example https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/veckulu5rwkdc/tests/:server:test/org.elasticsearch.common.logging.JsonThrowablePatternConverterTests/testStacktraceWithJson?top-execution=1

This is failing fairly often on `8.0` https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/fi6ag7co3icxu

@pgomulka Could we backport the fix there too?
